title: This Bird Stays in the Air for Ten Months. Where Does It Sleep?
subject: common swift

scenes.text: A bird that never lands for ten months. Where does it sleep?
It's the common swift. Scientists tracked thirteen of them with tiny sensors through the whole non-breeding season.
Some never touched down at all. The rest spent over 99 percent of that time in the air.
At dawn and dusk they climb to between 6,500 and 9,800 feet.
So when do they sleep? Researchers think they may doze while gliding. They admit they're not sure.
Ten months of flying. So where does a swift sleep? Up there, maybe still flying.

description:
A common swift can stay airborne for about ten months without landing.
Researchers tracked 13 birds and found some never landed at all, while the rest spent over 99.5 percent of the time flying. How they sleep is still an open question.
Where do you think a swift sleeps?
first_comment: Would you believe a bird can sleep while flying? Tell me your guess.
